implementation_completion: Validated for the supplied signed-E2 dataset and the declared finite research checks
remaining_research_limits: The seven-family synthetic signed-E2 corpus is not an independently authored or external replication.
Finite conformance and differential checks do not prove full implementation refinement to the Lean model.

The formal model assumes authenticated observations and validated capability facts; native public data verifies configured signatures but does not prove every scope, authorization or timing assertion independently.
Synthetic E2 signatures do not establish trustworthy real execution time, physical deletion or absence of undisclosed copies.
The optional E3-E5 and network backends have focused conformance/fault checks; the provided dataset does not validate real mechanism attestation or arbitrary Byzantine executions.
Authenticated no-applicable-obligation certificates are not implemented by the native input profile; empty scopes are rejected.
Incremental validation snapshots require explicit revocation updates and epoch changes from their trusted supplier.
C-PaE replay and transition components are research conformance components; this audit does not establish an end-to-end distributed protocol refinement theorem.
